name: github
description: Gives an agent GitHub's own tools, plus git and gh, on only the repositories you pick: read code, open issues and pull requests, push branches. You install the hachiflow GitHub App and choose the repositories, and the agent gets a token that lasts an hour and works only on those. Nothing long-lived is pasted or stored, so there is no token to leak or forget to rotate. You can revoke access any time on GitHub, under Settings, Applications, Installed GitHub Apps. Not an official GitHub integration. Maintained by hachiflow, not by GitHub.

tools.name: read_code
tools.description: Read files, branches and commits in the repositories you picked.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search code, issues and pull requests in those repositories.

tools.name: read_threads
tools.description: Read issues and pull requests, with their comments, reviews and changes.

tools.name: edit_issues
tools.description: Open, edit and comment on issues.

tools.name: push_code
tools.description: Create branches and push commits, with git or GitHub's tools. Changes to workflow files are refused.

tools.name: pull_requests
tools.description: Open, review, comment on and merge pull requests.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub
